title: permissions.yaml
description: The permission hierarchy of a brain (brain.permissions, docs/permissions.md): its sections and a rule's keys, as brain.permissions reads them. It describes the format for brain schema diff and the fixtures (wi-brain-permissions-schema); brain.permissions still reads the file itself (its keys are its constants: SECTIONS, RULE_KEYS, NEVER_KEYS), and a test keeps the two in step. It is never stricter than the module: a section left empty (null) is accepted, as an empty file is; what this subset cannot say (v once the file holds anything, exactly one of allow, ask or deny, one level at a time, a non-empty title) brain.permissions checks.

never.description: The categories no level may allow, extended by this file: category -> its patterns, why, deny rules and probes.

rule.description: One rule: one verdict (allow, ask or deny) and its pattern, at most one level's selector (project with machine is the local level), why, and its provenance.
